{{Quote|Zebular is my valet, and so much more: bodyguard, confidante... he's a licensed attorney in more than five hundred systems!|Tharan Cedrax, about Zebular|<ref name="Onslaught" />}}
'''Zebular''' was a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] lifeform that was [[Tharan Cedrax]]'s assistant. Zebular was given as a gift to Cedrax from [[Holiday (hologram)|Holiday]], his companion, who left Cedrax to travel [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Zebular took the form of a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Houk/Legends|Houk]].<ref name="Onslaught" />
